hotels.title: Great Ocean Road Boutique Escape with A$50 Dining Credit & Nightly Drink
hotels.description: Perched on the iconic Great Ocean Road, Lorne Hotel offers a relaxed yet refined boutique escape with panoramic coastal views. Its prime location places you directly opposite the beach, making it easy to enjoy the sand and surf that the region is renowned for. The hotel's bistro and breezy beer garden serve up classic Australian pub fare alongside local beers and wine. Whether you're dining indoors or soaking up the sun outside, the stunning bay views enhance every meal. For a special occasion, Totti’s offers Italian-inspired dishes designed for sharing, perfect for gathering with friends and family. With just 11 rooms at the hotel, you can soak up the seaside serenity in a quiet retreat, equipped with modern amenities to ensure a comfortable stay. Beyond the hotel, Lorne's vibrant shopping and dining precinct is a short stroll away with a variety of restaurants, cafes and boutiques to explore. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, Lorne Hotel provides a welcoming base for your next coastal escape.

hotels.title: Great Ocean Road Escape at Lorne's Only Beachfront Hotel with Mineral Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Set off for Victoria's iconic Great Ocean Road and immerse yourself in scenic seaside charm at Mantra Lorne, the beloved coastal town's only beachfront hotel. Built around Erskine House, the oldest operating guesthouse in Victoria, this heritage resort still provides all the modern comforts you need for a relaxing stay. What's more, you’re in prime position to explore the rugged cliffs, quiet beaches, and lush forests of the Great Ocean Road, or Lorne's collection of boutiques, galleries and eateries. Set in 12 acres of landscaped gardens including tennis courts and croquet lawns, this seaside resort has everything you need right on your doorstep. Take a dip in the heated mineral pool, unwind in the steam room or enjoy a hearty meal at The Larder.
